<thought>From the 13C NMR data, peaks in the methyl region are at 26.40 ppm (one CH₃), 36.40 ppm (two distinct CH₃ groups that happen to have the same shift), and 58.70 ppm (a methoxy CH₃). This gives a total of 4 methyl (CH₃) groups in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
